name: The Com
description: The Com (short for 'The Community') is a transnational English-speaking online criminal network primarily composed of teenagers and young adults from the US and UK. It operates as a loose umbrella community facilitating cryptocurrency theft, SIM swapping, social engineering, extortion, and swatting. Member groups include Scattered Spider, Lapsus$, and ShinyHunters.

sources.title: The Com: the growing cybercrime network — The Guardian
